name: 原声Woods低语
lyrics:
[主歌1]

I walk 穿过 the woods where the autumn leaves fall
Following the path of an old guitar's call
The morning 光芒 whispers 穿过 branches so high
A story of wanderers beneath the 湛蓝 天空

[副歌]

Oh, woods of whispers, speak 轻柔 to my soul
Your colors of amber and rust make me whole
With every step deeper, I find where I belong
A melody flows where I've always felt strong

[主歌2]

The river runs quiet beside the old stone
A hummingbird hovers, no longer alone
The pine trees stand tall like the legends of old
Their shadows are dancing, the stories unfold

[副歌]

Oh, woods of whispers, speak 轻柔 to my soul
Your colors of amber and rust make me whole
With every step deeper, I find where I belong
A melody flows where I've always felt strong

[尾声]

As the sun paints the horizon in golden hue
I'll carry this music forever with you

name: 原声CountryWanderer
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Along the winding country lane,
Sunlight flickers 穿过 the trees,
Every step feels like a memory,
Carried gently on the breeze.

[副歌]

We are wanderers finding our way,
穿过 the golden 光芒 of afternoon,
No need to hurry, no need to stay,
Just letting the world play its tune.

[主歌2]

The maple leaves are turning gold,
A gentle rustle overhead,
Stories written in the 寂静,
Echo softly as I read.

[副歌]

We are wanderers finding our way,
穿过 the golden 光芒 of afternoon,
Every mile just makes it clearer,
That the journey is our room.
